name: Saturn sUSDat
oneLiner: sUSDat is Saturn's USDat-denominated credit vault, backed mainly by STRCon exposure to Strategy preferred shares and exited through a withdrawal queue.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The native ERC-4626 receipt accepts USDat, but totalAssets includes a dominant STRCon position rather than preserving the cash-backed parent reserve. At Ethereum block 26197300 (2026-10-15T10:25:11Z), STRCon recognized value was 50,957,019.855957 USDat-equivalent out of 51,544,690.719554 totalAssets. Ondo identifies STRCon as Strategy Stretch Preferred exposure and its family documents describe structured notes issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited. The local rwa-credit-fund override preserves preferred-equity, note-issuer and Saturn operational risks; it does not assert direct ownership, enforceable priority or a complete legal recovery claim. Missing exact terms remain unavailable, and no numerical rating is promised.

collateral: Ethereum vault-held STRCon structured notes tracking Strategy Stretch Preferred (STRC), plus a USDat liquidity buffer. At block 26197300 (2026-10-15T10:25:11Z), gross reserves were 98.859881% STRCon recognized value and 1.140119% actual USDat; the legacy STRC mirror and unvested surplus were zero. STRCon is an Ondo note, not direct ownership of Strategy shares. Exact Saturn gift, seniority, legal recovery and whole-book independent reconciliation remain unverified.
pegMechanism: USDat deposits mint ERC-4626 shares priced from USDat accounting balances and STRCon recognized value. Credit dividends and vested surplus can increase the share exchange rate, while preferred-share losses can reduce it. Holders request queued USDat redemption and receive an NFT; an operator processes requests using available USDat and STRCon unwind proceeds before the holder claims. V2 fees are Regular (0 bps deposit, 10 bps redemption) or Elevated (25 bps deposit, 50 bps redemption), set by operator. The issuer targets same-day/T+1 processing, but liquidity, holder limits, pauses and restrictions can extend waits; no binding maximum delay or full stressed redemption capacity is established. The runbook's initial buy/sell allowance is 6 million USDat with a 6 million USDat/day refill, not promised withdrawal capacity. Exact Ethereum Curve trading provides a separate, depth-limited USDC exit; neither route guarantees par or immediate whole-position liquidity.

notices.message: Most vault NAV is STRCon, an Ondo structured note tracking Strategy preferred shares. Cash-backed USDat is only a liquidity buffer. Exact note terms, Saturn holder priority and executed recovery arrangements have not been verified; on-chain holdings do not establish legal ownership or independent financial assurance. Queued redemption depends on operator processing and realizable liquidity, with no verified maximum delay.
